# temps_service_connection (Data Source)

The variables a linked service injects into a project (for PostgreSQL: `POSTGRES_URL`, `POSTGRES_HOST`, `POSTGRES_PASSWORD`, ...). The values include credentials: they are sensitive and end up in the Terraform state. Needs the `external_services:read` permission, and a role allowed to read plaintext service credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Connection variables a linked project receives (for example POSTGRES_URL).
data "temps_service_connection" "db" {
  service_id = temps_service.db.id
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) ID of a project linked to the service (see `temps_service_link`).
- `service_id` (Number) ID of the service.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<service_id>/<project_id>`.
- `variables` (Map of String, Sensitive) Variable name to value.
